signInBody: This workspace belongs to you alone. You sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN.
useRecoveryCode: Sign in with a recovery code
recoveryCodeHint: One of the 10 codes you printed at setup, for example K7QM-2XRA-9DPV. Each code works once.
addThisDeviceBody: To add your phone or another computer, get the 6-digit code on a signed-in device under Settings › Account › Add a new device.
pairSubmit: Check the code and create a passkey
setupBody: Setup happens once. A passkey is created on this device; then you add your phone too.
setupTokenHint: The key Mehmet saved as SETUP_TOKEN on Vercel. It makes sure only you can run setup.
setupTokenMissing: Add SETUP_TOKEN to the Vercel environment variables before setup.
recoveryBody: Print these 10 codes or keep them somewhere safe. If you lose every device with a passkey, these codes get you in. They will not be shown again.

errors.setup_done: Setup is already done. Go to the sign-in page.
errors.setup_token: The setup key is not correct.
errors.setup_token_missing: Add SETUP_TOKEN to the Vercel environment variables before setup.
errors.challenge: The session expired. Reload the page and try again.
errors.verify: The passkey could not be verified. Could you try again?
errors.unknown_passkey: This passkey is not registered for this workspace.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.bad_code: This code is not valid or was already used.
errors.pairing_code: The code is wrong or expired. Get a new code.
errors.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Use a current Safari, Chrome or Edge.
